voName.title: Name of the Perun virtual organization
voName.description: Maps to VO attribute "displayName" in AAI for human-readable repository name in GUI.

voShortName.title: Short name of the Perun virtual organization
voShortName.description: Short repository name used by the authentication and authorisation infrastructure. Maps to VO attribute "shortName" in AAI for human-readable repository ID in GUI.

facilityId.title: Perun facility ID
facilityId.description: Repository identifier used by the access control system. Maps to facility attribute "id" as permanent unique repository ID.

loginUrl.title: Login URL
loginUrl.description: Maps to Facility attribute "loginUrl" in AAI for manual validation.

aaiUap.title: Provisioning
aaiUap.description: Information about provisioning user access for the repository.

aaiRbac.title: RBAC
aaiRbac.description: Information about the repository implementing centralized role-based access control.

aaiPbac.title: PBAC
aaiPbac.description: Information about the repository implementing centralized policy-based access control.
